The private club for refined menswear.

Ad Lux is a Toronto-based luxury menswear house shaped by Napoli tailoring — soft construction, refined proportions, and effortless Italian elegance. Private service. Quiet confidence.

The House

Luxury without noise.

Ad Lux is designed as a modern private menswear house: intimate, masculine, precise, and quietly luxurious. Inspired by Napoli and Ravello, our approach favours soft tailoring, natural lines, fine cloth, and effortless Italian elegance.
